selected_scope.title: LC Office Scrap Quantity/Distribution Investigation
selected_scope.finding: Existing Offense evidence does not establish an LC Office-specific low generated-count regression. S1.42AJ-DIAG1 LC Office generated 14 base scrap plus one additional replicated object (15 tracked total); S1.42AJ-DIAG2 LC Office generated/finalized 15. Comparable normal Offense runs start from 14 base scrap: S1.42AJ Facility was later inflated by BCMER PlentyOutsideScrap, while accepted S1.42AK Spooky Manor finalized at 15. Existing logs do not provide complete item-to-room/floor placement for the LC Office set.
selected_scope.analysis_contract: Treat generated quantity as provisionally comparable and do not increase scrap count. Design an isolated diagnostic-only artifact derived from exact accepted S1.42AK that logs each final spawned scrap object's identity and world position plus enough LC Office floor/room context to evaluate clustering and practical discoverability. The diagnostic must not alter quantity, rarity, value or placement and must not include unrelated scopes.
selected_scope.next_action: Design the minimal diagnostic-only LC Office scrap placement instrumentation from exact accepted S1.42AK. Do not arm a runtime test or change gameplay tuning until the diagnostic implementation and static review are complete.
currently_irrelevant_actions: Do not increase LC Office scrap quantity: existing LC Office 14-15 base/final counts are comparable to nearby normal Offense evidence.
Do not treat the S1.42AJ Facility final count of 29 as a normal comparator because BCMER PlentyOutsideScrap inflated that run.
Do not arm a runtime test until placement instrumentation has been designed, implemented and statically reviewed.
Do not combine universal interior viability, CullFactory, MelanieMausoleum fog, Black Mesa/Pikmin routing, LethalEscape or other deferred scopes into this investigation.
